location_fine: bare white waiting room with red armchairs
visual_synopsis: In a bare white room with two red armchairs and an old CRT TV on a stand, a heavyset man in a fedora and dark suit shows a videotape to a woman (played by a male actor in a curly wig and cardigan); she reacts, argues and eventually cries in close-up. After a fade to black he is replaced in the same seat by a long-haired mustached man in a white shirt, the exchange repeats, and the sketch ends on the two empty chairs.
